description:
Yi-won is a university student who was left desperate after being fired from the private tutoring job he had barely managed to secure after returning to school. By chance in that exact moment, he runs into the school's popular star, Jeong Hae-jun, ends up venting about his situation to him, and they exchange phone numbers. Though Yi-won assumes it was just an empty polite gesture, a message actually arrives from Jeong Hae-jun, who offers to set him up as a tutor for his cousin, Choi Jeong-seo.

*“Why are you suddenly being so nice to me?”*  
*“Do you dislike it?”*

Because they were practically strangers, Yi-won feels something is slightly suspicious. However, due to Hae-jun’s reassurance that he had simply wanted to get closer all along, combined with his own unavoidable financial crisis, Yi-won ultimately accepts the offer. Fortunately, the tutoring job turns out to be incredibly easy, and he is thrilled to be earning much more money—until one day, Choi Jeong-seo, who is an elite dominant Omega, deliberately releases pheromones to provoke him. With the situation spiraling out of his control, Yi-won desperately calls Jeong Hae-jun for help and manages to escape the immediate crisis.

*“W-what do you think you’re doing?!”*  
*“Hyung, you’re pretty. I also like the fact that your cock doesn't have any hair.”*

But as Jeong Hae-jun finally reveals his true, aggressive colors, Yi-won finds himself plunged right back into jeopardy... *(Source: RIDI novel page, translated)*
